---
title: "VS Code"
---

VS Code sits in the middle: you install it once, and in return you get one
editor for LaTeX, R, Python and everything else, with settings and keybindings
you can shape. What you can change is bounded by the extensions that exist.

The [VS Code guide](../vscode/index.qmd) covers installation, our recommended
profile, the extensions it brings, and how to customise it afterwards.
